title: OEDS Brennstoffe & Strompreis
description: Day-ahead electricity prices (ENTSO-E) against gas (TGE), coal (PSCMI1), CO2 (EU ETS) and oil prices; clean spark and clean dark spreads. Default range 2024-01..2026-01: the instrat_pl coal series and the OPEC oil series end in early 2026.

panels.title: Data status of the sources used
panels.description: First and latest timestamp per table, age of the latest value and approximate row count. Status compares the age with the update cadence of the source: OK within the expected age, LATE up to 3x, STALE beyond; 'static' tables are not updated any more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'instrat_pl.gas_price (TGE day-ahead gas)' AS "Table", (min(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "First", (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('instrat_pl.gas_price'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 48 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 48 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 144 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM instrat_pl.gas_price
UNION ALL
SELECT 'instrat_pl.eu_ets (EUA)' AS "Table", (min(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "First", (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('instrat_pl.eu_ets'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 48 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 48 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 144 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM instrat_pl.eu_ets
UNION ALL
SELECT 'instrat_pl.coal_price (PSCMI1, monthly)' AS "Table", (min(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "First", (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('instrat_pl.coal_price'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 1080 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 1080 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 3240 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM instrat_pl.coal_price
UNION ALL
SELECT 'opec.opec (crude oil)' AS "Table", (min(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "First", (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('opec.opec'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 168 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 168 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))/3600 <= 504 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM opec.opec
UNION ALL
SELECT 'entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices' AS "Table", min(index) AS "First", max(index) AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - max(index))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 48 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - max(index))/3600 <= 48 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - max(index))/3600 <= 144 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices

options.content:
**Fuel prices**: gas = Polish TGE day-ahead gas (`instrat_pl.gas_price`, index `tgegasda`, PLN converted to EUR by the crawler, EUR/MWh, gross calorific basis). It is a Polish price, not TTF or THE; the level is typically a few EUR/MWh above TTF. Coal = Polish steam coal index PSCMI1 (`instrat_pl.coal_price`, monthly, EUR/GJ x 3.6 = EUR/MWh thermal). CO2 = EUA price (`instrat_pl.eu_ets`, index `t3pa`, EUR/t). Oil = crude oil (`opec.opec`, EUR per kWh x 1000). Each day uses the last known value (gas, CO2, oil up to 7 days old, coal up to 45 days old, i.e. the monthly value applies for the whole month).

**Electricity price**: ENTSO-E day-ahead price of the selected zone, daily baseload mean.

**Clean spark spread** = power price - gas price / efficiency - emission factor / efficiency x EUA, with a gas plant efficiency of the variable (default 50 %, CCGT, LHV) and an emission factor of 0.202 t CO2 per MWh thermal.
**Clean dark spread** = power price - coal price / efficiency - emission factor / efficiency x EUA, with coal plant efficiency from the variable (default 38 %) and 0.341 t CO2 per MWh thermal (hard coal).
Gas prices on gross calorific basis are used as if net (LHV), which overstates the gas cost by about 10 %; variable costs other than fuel and CO2 (O&M, grid fees) are not included. Default zone is PL (the fuel prices are Polish); with DE_LU the Polish fuel prices are only a proxy for German fuel costs. Default range 2024-01..2026-01.

panels.title: Day-ahead price
panels.description: Mean day-ahead price of the selected zone over the time range, EUR/MWh (ENTSO-E).

targets.rawSql:
WITH gv AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, price_eur_per_mwh AS v FROM instrat_pl.gas_price WHERE indeks = 'tgegasda') x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
ev AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, eur_per_tco2 AS v FROM instrat_pl.eu_ets WHERE indeks = 't3pa') x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
cv AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, steam_coal_eur_per_gj * 3.6 AS v FROM instrat_pl.coal_price) x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
ov AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, euro_per_kwh * 1000 AS v FROM opec.opec) x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
f AS (
  SELECT d.t, d.price AS da, g.v AS gas, e.v AS eua, c.v AS coal, o.v AS oil,
    d.price - g.v / ${eff_gas} - 0.202 / ${eff_gas} * e.v AS spark,
    d.price - c.v / ${eff_coal} - 0.341 / ${eff_coal} * e.v AS dark,
    g.v / ${eff_gas} + 0.202 / ${eff_gas} * e.v AS srmc_gas, c.v / ${eff_coal} + 0.341 / ${eff_coal} * e.v AS srmc_coal
  FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', "index") AS t, avg(value) AS price FROM entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = '${zone}' GROUP BY 1) d
  LEFT JOIN gv g ON d.t::timestamp >= g.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(g.d1, g.d0 + interval '7 days')
  LEFT JOIN ev e ON d.t::timestamp >= e.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(e.d1, e.d0 + interval '7 days')
  LEFT JOIN cv c ON d.t::timestamp >= c.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(c.d1, c.d0 + interval '45 days')
  LEFT JOIN ov o ON d.t::timestamp >= o.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(o.d1, o.d0 + interval '7 days'))
SELECT avg(da) AS v FROM f

panels.description: Mean clean spark spread over the time range for the zones chosen in the variable 'Zones to compare', ranked (EUR/MWh electric, same fuel and CO2 prices for all zones).

targets.rawSql:
WITH gv AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, price_eur_per_mwh AS v FROM instrat_pl.gas_price WHERE indeks = 'tgegasda') x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
ev AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, eur_per_tco2 AS v FROM instrat_pl.eu_ets WHERE indeks = 't3pa') x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
cv AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, steam_coal_eur_per_gj * 3.6 AS v FROM instrat_pl.coal_price) x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
ov AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, euro_per_kwh * 1000 AS v FROM opec.opec) x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
f AS (
  SELECT d.t, d.zone, d.price AS da, g.v AS gas, e.v AS eua, c.v AS coal, o.v AS oil,
    d.price - g.v / ${eff_gas} - 0.202 / ${eff_gas} * e.v AS spark,
    d.price - c.v / ${eff_coal} - 0.341 / ${eff_coal} * e.v AS dark,
    g.v / ${eff_gas} + 0.202 / ${eff_gas} * e.v AS srmc_gas, c.v / ${eff_coal} + 0.341 / ${eff_coal} * e.v AS srmc_coal
  FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', "index") AS t, country AS zone, avg(value) AS price FROM entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country IN ($cmp_zones) GROUP BY 1, 2) d
  LEFT JOIN gv g ON d.t::timestamp >= g.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(g.d1, g.d0 + interval '7 days')
  LEFT JOIN ev e ON d.t::timestamp >= e.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(e.d1, e.d0 + interval '7 days')
  LEFT JOIN cv c ON d.t::timestamp >= c.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(c.d1, c.d0 + interval '45 days')
  LEFT JOIN ov o ON d.t::timestamp >= o.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(o.d1, o.d0 + interval '7 days'))
SELECT zone, avg(spark) AS "clean spark spread EUR/MWh" FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly averages
panels.description: Monthly mean of the daily values (selected zone): day-ahead price, gas, coal, CO2 and oil prices, short-run marginal costs of the gas and coal plant, clean spark and dark spreads. EUR/MWh (CO2 in EUR/t).

targets.rawSql:
WITH gv AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, price_eur_per_mwh AS v FROM instrat_pl.gas_price WHERE indeks = 'tgegasda') x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
ev AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, eur_per_tco2 AS v FROM instrat_pl.eu_ets WHERE indeks = 't3pa') x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
cv AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, steam_coal_eur_per_gj * 3.6 AS v FROM instrat_pl.coal_price) x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
ov AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT date AS d0, coalesce(lead(date) OVER (ORDER BY date), 'infinity') AS d1, euro_per_kwh * 1000 AS v FROM opec.opec) x WHERE d0 >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '60 days' AND d0 <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
f AS (
  SELECT d.t, d.price AS da, g.v AS gas, e.v AS eua, c.v AS coal, o.v AS oil,
    d.price - g.v / ${eff_gas} - 0.202 / ${eff_gas} * e.v AS spark,
    d.price - c.v / ${eff_coal} - 0.341 / ${eff_coal} * e.v AS dark,
    g.v / ${eff_gas} + 0.202 / ${eff_gas} * e.v AS srmc_gas, c.v / ${eff_coal} + 0.341 / ${eff_coal} * e.v AS srmc_coal
  FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', "index") AS t, avg(value) AS price FROM entsoe.query_day_ahead_prices WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = '${zone}' GROUP BY 1) d
  LEFT JOIN gv g ON d.t::timestamp >= g.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(g.d1, g.d0 + interval '7 days')
  LEFT JOIN ev e ON d.t::timestamp >= e.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(e.d1, e.d0 + interval '7 days')
  LEFT JOIN cv c ON d.t::timestamp >= c.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(c.d1, c.d0 + interval '45 days')
  LEFT JOIN ov o ON d.t::timestamp >= o.d0 AND d.t::timestamp < least(o.d1, o.d0 + interval '7 days'))
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', t), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", round(avg(da)::numeric, 1) AS "Day-ahead", round(avg(gas)::numeric, 1) AS "Gas", round(avg(coal)::numeric, 1) AS "Coal (th)",
  round(avg(eua)::numeric, 1) AS "CO2 EUR/t", round(avg(oil)::numeric, 1) AS "Oil (th)", round(avg(srmc_gas)::numeric, 1) AS "SRMC gas", round(avg(srmc_coal)::numeric, 1) AS "SRMC coal",
  round(avg(spark)::numeric, 1) AS "Spark spread", round(avg(dark)::numeric, 1) AS "Dark spread"
FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
